MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Aquaculture.

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Production Systems? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Production Systems.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Production Systems.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Production Systems.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Production Systems.

14. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

15. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Safety and Survival Techniques / and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
